nodes.label: admin
nodes.note: Administration outside meetings: parameter sets with inline editing and the daily import batch monitor.

nodes.label: clients
nodes.note: Client search, client overview with product group cards (key indicators, sparklines, Start meeting / Prepare) and role classification.

nodes.label: cover
nodes.note: Cover position of a session: cover ratio per month and sub-product, and quotes for the uncovered part.

nodes.label: market
nodes.note: Market scenarios of a session: price and transport price shocks on top of the baseline curve, with live path preview.

nodes.label: meetings
nodes.note: Meeting session lifecycle: create CLIENT or PREPARATION sessions, list and close them, override the client role, show the session summary.

nodes.label: presentation
nodes.note: Second-screen view of a CLIENT session (`/present/:sessionId`): follows the representative's route and filters without any internal controls.

nodes.label: product1
nodes.note: Product 1 overview per city hub: the four cumulative projection tables, cover ratio chart, movement input and peer simulation modals.

nodes.label: product2
nodes.note: Product 2 overview per transport mode, reusing the projection tables, cover chart and modals of product1.

nodes.label: reports
nodes.note: Meeting report of a closed session: payload preview, PDF download and regeneration.

nodes.label: stress
nodes.note: Stress test per scenario: monthly exposure table by city or transport mode plus the transport price chart.
